name: The Strength of Corruption
summary: At Camp Mojache, Talo Thornhoof sends you north to Felwood to judge the strength of its tainted beasts.

sections.title: Know Your Enemy
sections.body: Talo Thornhoof hunts by studying the strengths of his foes. He believes knowing an enemy can turn a battle in your favor. Felwood lies north of Ashenvale, where fel has tainted the creatures. Talo fears its maddened bears and wolves have grown stronger. Face twelve Angerclaw grizzlies and twelve Felpaw ravagers there. Fel-touched creatures glow a strange green. Talo senses that fel is evil, yet very powerful.

sections.title: What Talo Hears
sections.body: After hearing your account, Talo finds mindless ferocity in the beasts. He warns you to stay alert and learn more about the corruption. An enemy should always be known.

aliases: who gives the strength of corruption
faq.answer: Talo Thornhoof, a hunter at Camp Mojache in Feralas, sends you to Felwood.

faq.q: Why does Talo Thornhoof want the beasts of Felwood faced?
aliases: why kill the bears and wolves
purpose of the strength of corruption
faq.answer: Talo believes knowing an enemy can turn a battle, and wants you to learn whether Felwood's fel-tainted creatures are as strong as believed.

faq.q: Which creatures are targeted in Felwood?
faq.answer: You face twelve Angerclaw grizzlies and twelve Felpaw ravagers in Felwood.

faq.q: What does Talo say about fel?
faq.answer: Talo senses that fel is evil but very powerful, and the creatures it touches glow a strange green.
